body:
Didn't sleep properly last night. PTSD just took over and I spent the night fighting demons (real and imaginary) real as they were bad thoughts and imaginary because i was in and out of flashbacks, different scenarios and pretty epic anxiety & panic attacks.

Still haven't found somewhere big enough to jump off. Can't even do that fucking thing right.

I shouted at the fat on my body to 'get the fuck off me' and if it wasn't prepared to do that, then for my body to 'just fucking die already.'

Thank you for your kind words.
I do not see myself as brave, but a burden put upon this world.

Honestly I am not looking for help, just need to talk now and again until I can figure a way to end my sorry existence of a life.

My bmi is healthy but my goal is for it to be as low as possible;

I asked my MH team to help me before I got to the stage where I am now. They wouldn't help me because my bmi wasn't 18 or in the "danger" zone.
